SELF LUBE CAST IRON FLANGE BEARING UNITS
tech: The MFC RHP is a heavy-duty, four-bolt round flanged cartridge bearing unit engineered by RHP Bearings. It belongs to the Self-Lube family of mounted bearings, specifically built to support rotating shafts passing through walls, bulkheads, or frame structures. The MFC series is the round, circular flange on the back of the casting. It includes a raised, concentric register step (the spigot). The design relieves the four mounting bolts from carrying heavy radial shear loads, instead channeling the physical forces directly into the framework. Material : A rugged BS1452 grey cast iron housing fitted with a through-hardened high-carbon chromium steel ball bearing insert. Features are : Spherical Self-Alignment Capability, Pre-Lubricated Assembly, High-Speed Stability, Anti-Rotation Pin, Locking Mechanics & Shaft Interfacing, Low Thermal Conductivity. Applications : Material Handling & Conveyor Systems, Agricultural Machinery, Food Processing & Packaging Production, Air Handling & Ventilation Systems, Textile & Printing Machinery, Mining, Quarrying & Construction Machinery.

Features are : Superior Corrosion Resistance, Hygienic Design, Self-Aligning Capability, Reinforced Mounting Holes, Food-Grade Lubrication, Vibration Damping & Quiet Operation, Reduced Noise, Ease of Installation, Low Water Absorption, Chemical and UV Resistance. Applications : Food and Beverage Processing, Meat and Poultry Processing,  Pharmaceutical and Medical Industries, Pulp and Paper Mills, Agricultural Equipment, Marine and Coastal Environments, Textile Industry, General Material Handling, Car Wash Systems, Seeding and Sorting Machines.

Pillow (plummer) block ball bearing units consist of an insert bearing mounted in a cast iron housing that can be bolted to a support surface. This variant is suitable for high temperature applications, and for both constant and alternating directions of rotation. It has an inner ring extended on both sides and is locked onto the shaft by tightening a set screw on the inner ring, making it easy to mount. Features are : For high temperature applications, Designed for a constant and alternating rotation, Ready to mount, Lubricated and sealed bearing, Quick locking onto the shaft. Applications : Material Handling Systems, Machinery in Dry Environments, Metals & Glass Production, Food and Beverage Industry, Automotive and Aerospace, Power Generation & Chemical Processing. TF=Y-Bearing Of Series YAR2-2F (Inner Ring Extended At Both Sides, Grub Screw Locking), Standard Seal And Plain Flinger At Each Side, VA201=Bearing For High-Temperature Applications (e.g. Kiln Trucks).

It has a narrow inner ring and is locked onto the shaft by an eccentric locking collar, making it easy to mount. Features are : Ready to mount, Lubricated and sealed bearing, Designed for rotation in one direction, Accommodate static initial misalignment. Applications : Material handling systems, Agricultural machinery, Air handling, Construction machinery, Packaging systems, Textile equipment, Food and beverage processing, Pumps and fans, Power transmission systems, Special machinery. FM=Y-Bearing Of Series YET2 (Inner Ring Extended At One Side, Eccentric Locking Collar), Standard Seal Without Flinger At Each Side.

The SSUCT bearing is a stainless steel take-up bearing unit designed for use in environments requiring high corrosion resistance. It is a take-up bearing unit, meaning it is designed to be mounted in a guide frame and uses a positioning screw to adjust the bearing\'s position and maintain proper belt or chain tension in applications like conveyor systems. The bearing insert uses two grub (set) screws for secure and precise shaft mounting. Material : The housing is made from SUS304 stainless steel, and the inner/outer rings and balls of the insert bearing are made from SUS440 stainless steel for superior corrosion resistance. The insert features silicone rubber seals for effective protection against dust and contamination. Features are : Ease of Maintenance, Self-Alignment Capability, Low Noise and Vibration, Operating Temperature Range, Anti-Rotation Pin, Hygiene & Washdown Suitability. Applications : Food and Beverage Processing, Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Chemical and Agricultural Machinery, Marine and Coastal Environments, Water Treatment Facilities, Textile Industry, Pulp and Paper Mills, Mining and Ore Processing.

desc: TWO BOLT SELF -LUBE CAST IRON FLANGE BEARING UNIT
tech: The SFT is a premium-grade, two-bolt oval cast iron flange bearing unit manufactured by RHP. It is primarily used to support a rotating engineering shaft when the mounting surface is perpendicular to the shaft axis. The spherical outer ring of the bearing matches the internal seat of the housing. This allows the assembly to automatically pivot and self-align, compensating for initial structural setup misalignments. Material : A rugged gray cast iron housing fitted with a through-hardened chrome steel bearing insert. Features are : Space-Saving Footprint, Maintenance-Friendly Re-lubrication, Load Distribution, Anti-Rotation Pin, Reliable Shaft Locking Methods, Friction Reduction, Super Finished Raceways, High Radial & Axial Support. Applications : Conveyor Systems & Material Handling, Agricultural Machinery, Food, Beverage & Packaging Processing, HVAC & Air Moving Equipment, Printing Presses & Paper Converting, Woodworking Machinery, Waste Management & Recycling Equipment, Marine, Port, and Offshore Machinery, Construction, Quarrying, and Mining Systems, Textile Machinery & Renewable Energy.

BEARING = MB4-12, HOUSING = LX204. The MBLX2 series are narrow-width, two-bolt flange mounted ball bearing units designed for medium-duty applications. With a narrow flange design and standard load ratings, these bearings fit a wide range of medium-duty industrial applications. Applications : Food and beverage processing, Packaging machinery, Washdown environments, Conveyors and material handling.

Bearing unit supplied with a fully sealed bearing insert fitted in the threaded base housing and includes a grease nipple to facilitate re-lubrication. Benefits: Cost-effective bearing, housing assembly, re-lubricatable, replaceable insert, grub screw fixing.

US series extended inner ring on one side, fixing to shaft using set screws, optional design as floating bearing, seals on both sides. These bearing units are supplied with a fully sealed bearing insert fitted in the housing and include a grease nipple to facilitate re-lubrication. The bearing insert has 2 grub screws to allow tightening against the shaft once fitted. The inserts can be removed from the housings for future replacement as required. Benefits: Can be re-lubricated, replaceable bearing insert, grub screw fixing.

T3 : Take-up housing made of grey cast iron with taking up for threaded rod and nut, guide groove on both sides, relubricatable. UC series extended inner ring on both sides, fixing to shaft using set screws, optional design as floating bearing, seals on both sides with additional slingers, also available with triple seals. These heavy-duty bearing units are supplied with a fully sealed bearing insert fitted in the housing and includes a grease nipple to facilitate re-lubrication. The bearing insert has 2 grub screws to allow tightening against the shaft once fitted. The inserts can be removed from the housing for future replacement as required. Benefits: Can be re-lubricated, replaceable bearing insert, grub screw fixing.

desc: CAST IRON HOUSINGS WITH CHROME STEEL BEARING INSERTS (Hang Up Unit - EHE2)
tech: ESEHE201 = Complete Bearing With Housing, Bearing Insert = ES201G2, Housing = EHE203. EHE : Hanger housing made of grey cast iron with metric fixing threads, relubricatable. The EHE2 series from SNR are hanger-style self-aligning bearing units. They feature a cast-iron housing and are available with different locking/fixing systems. Designed for convenient mounting - often suspended via a slot—they offer versatility across industrial setups. The ESEHE series (also designated as EHE with eccentric collar locking) are industrial hanger-style mounted units. EXEHE: Combines eccentric collar locking with features of the EHE2 series. USEHE: Likely similar to UCEHE but with a standard set-screw and simpler seal type. UKEHE‑H (Adapter Sleeve locking - heavy-duty version).

desc: STAINLESS STEEL HOUSINGS WITH STAINLESS STEEL BEARING INSERTS (PILLOW BLOCK UNITS)
tech: SUCP201 = Complete Bearing With Housing, Bearing Insert = SUC201, Housing = SP204. SP2: Conveyor belt tensioner housing made of grey cast iron, relubricatable. SUC: Stainless steel bearing insert with shaft fastening by socket set screw. Features are: Excellent mount stability and impact resistance, Recess-free housing contact surface to prevent deposits of the process material. Relubrication facility on all housings. Most of the bearing units made of cast iron or stainless steel can be equipped with additional protective covers.

TVN Plummer block bearing housings are designed for use with cylidrical bore, self aligning ball bearings. These housings are unsplit and are supplied as floating bearings.  A locating bearing arrangement is achieved by inserting fixing rings or intermediate rings.  Sealing is by means of felt strip. TVN housings are made from GG20.  For lubrication of these bearing units it is recommended that a high grade grease be used.  A R1/8\" grease hole is incorporated in the housing for eventual later greasing.

desc: SQUARE AND TRIANGULAR FLANGED ROLLER BEARING UNITS
tech: Four-bolt square flange roller bearing units with Type E dimensions consist of a spherical roller bearing mounted in a cast iron housing that can support rotating shafts through walls, bulkheads or other flat surfaces. The units are shaft-ready, pre-assembled and pre-greased, for installation right out of the box. Locating and non-locating variants can be specified while the standard set screw mounting accommodates rotation in both directions. End covers are optional. Ready to mount, Factory lubricated and sealed, Long service life, Minimal maintenance.

SUCFL consisting of a stainless steel ball bearing insert SUC and a stainless steel housing SFL the design as a 2-hole flange bearing allows installation in a variety of applications. even with limited space at the installation site and is suitable for high radial loads the housing is made of stainless steel and is therefore hygienic and corrosion-resistant the bearing insert made of stainless steel is also corrosion-resistant and has an extended inner ring with grub screws

EDH series is a sealing ring manufactured by FAG (part of Schaeffler). Specifically, it\'s designed for use with SES housings. These housings are split plummer block housings, a type of bearing housing known for their robust design and suitability for various applications like agricultural machinery and the steel industry. The EDH sealing ring is a double-lip seal, and its primary function is to prevent contaminants from entering the housing and to retain lubricant. The EDH seal is designed for use with SES housings, which are split plummer block housings. These housings are known for their robustness and suitability for demanding environments. Applications : The SES housings, and therefore the EDH seals, are used in various industries and applications, including agricultural machinery, paper processing, mining, and more.

The seal lips of the double lip seal EDH slide on the rotating shaft. The outer seal lip prevents ingress of contamination into the bearing. This effect is supported by the grease inserted between the seal lips on assembly. The inner lip prevents lubricant from escaping from the housing. The seal is made from acrylonitrile butadiene rubber NBR and is suitable for temperatures from –40 °C up to +100 °C. The double lip seal is a split seal. The seal halves are easily inserted in the annual slots of the housing parts. The permissible shaft misalignment is 0,5° in both directions.

Features are : Effective Sealing, Easy Lubrication, Standard-Duty, Fixed Mounting, Robust Corrosion Protection, Maintenance-Friendly. Applications : Food and beverage processing, Agricultural and farm equipment, Material handling in wet or chemical-exposed areas, Textile, printing, and construction applications.

The NTN EPB2 bearing is a high-performance, heavy-duty Type E two-bolt cast iron pillow block unit, specifically engineered for extreme industrial applications requiring superior load management, durability, and resilience to misalignment and contaminants. The bearing insert utilizes spherical rolling elements arranged in double rows. The contact surface of rollers is a line contact, enabling them to support significantly higher radial and axial loads than ball bearings. The self-aligning capability accommodates static and dynamic angular misalignment of up to ±2° without compromising performance or service life. A superior double-lip sealing construction is used, comprising an oil-resistant synthetic rubber seal and a metal flinger (slinger). This design creates a long path for contaminants and utilizes excess grease as an additional barrier, providing reliable protection in extreme environments. Features are : Self-Aligning Internal Bearing, Reduced Maintenance Costs, Superior Shock and Vibration Resistance. Applications : Conveyor systems, Mining and construction machinery, Pumps and gearboxes, Agricultural equipment, Steel & Metals Industry.

The SKF assortment includes units that are compliant with several industrial standards and meet many requirements. Features are : Ready to mount, Lubricated and sealed bearings, Quick locking on the shaft, Large variety of housing shapes, housing materials, and locking methods, Concentric locking options for high speeds and low vibration. Applications : Air Handling Units, Power Transmission, Conveyor Systems, HVAC Systems, Agricultural Machinery, Construction Equipment, Food and Beverage Processing. WF=Y-Bearing Of Series YEL2-2F (Inner Ring Extended At Both Sides, Eccentric Locking Collar), Standard Seal And Plain Flinger At Each Side, AH=Inner Diameter Different Than Standard.

Pillow (plummer) block ball bearing units consist of an insert bearing mounted in a cast iron housing that can be bolted to a support surface. This variant is suitable for applications where the direction of rotation is constant or alternating. It has an inner ring extended on both sides and is locked onto the shaft by tightening two set screws on the inner ring, making it easy to mount. The units are compliant with North American standards. Features are: Low centre height, Ready to mount, Lubricated and sealed bearing, Quick locking onto the shaft, Extended inner ring for minimized shaft misalignment. Applications: Material Handling Systems, Air Handling Units, Agricultural Machinery, General Industrial Equipment, Packaging Systems. TF= Y-Bearing Of Series YAR2-2F (Inner Ring Extended At Both Sides, Grub Screw Locking), Standard Seal And Plain Flinger At Each Side.

It has a narrow inner ring extended on one side and is locked onto the shaft by an eccentric locking collar, making it easy to mount. The units are compliant with North American standards. Features are : Low centre height, Ready to mount, Lubricated and sealed bearing, Quick locking onto the shaft, Narrow inner ring for tight operating spaces. Applications : Conveyor Systems, Agricultural Machinery, Packaging Systems, Air Handling Units, Textile Equipment, Construction Machinery, Food and Beverage Processing, Woodworking Machinery, Pumps and Compressors. FM=Y-Bearing Of Series YET2 (Inner Ring Extended At One Side, Eccentric Locking Collar), Standard Seal Without Flinger At Each Side.

The housing is made of reinforced PBT thermoplastic, while the bearing insert, seals, and zerk fittings are made of stainless steel (SUS materials) for maximum resistance to rust, frequent washdowns. Features are : Hygienic Compliance, Self-Aligning Ability, Vibration Damping and Noise Reduction, Thermal Insulation, Reinforced Mounting Holes, Self-Lubricating Properties, Food-Grade Lubrication and Sealing. Applications : Food Processing, Beverage & Bottling, Pharmaceutical and Medical Equipment, Chemical Processing, Material Handling and Conveyors, HVAC Systems, Printing Equipment, Renewable Energy Systems, Pulp and Paper Mills.

This facilitates assembly and maintenance and reduces the load on the entire setup. Finally, the stainless steel bearing is corrosion-resistant and therefore suitable for applications where exposure to moisture or chemicals occurs. OC=Open Cover.

The TP-SUCTB bearing is a specialized tapped-base pillow block bearing unit engineered for high-hygiene and corrosive environments. Designed for demanding environments like food processing and chemical industries. It combines a reinforced PBT (Polybutylene Terephthalate) thermoplastic housing with a 400-series martensitic stainless steel (SUC2) bearing insert that utilizes a set-screw locking mechanism. Features are : Hygiene & Compliance, Food-Grade Lubrication, Vibration & Noise Reduction, Locking Mechanism, Solid Base Design, Reinforced Mounting, Self-Alignment Capability, Anti-Bacterial Protection, Thermal Insulation. Applications : Pharmaceutical and Medical Equipment, Textile Machinery, Packaging Machinery, Electronic Equipment, Printing Equipment, Marine and Offshore, Automotive Wash Systems, Sewage Treatment Facilities, Bottling and Canning Lines.

Bearing insert features a stainless steel (typically AISI 440C) insert bearing for maximum corrosion resistance. Features are : Solid Base Design, Reinforced Mounting, Shaft Locking, Load Capacity, Anti-Bacterial Additives, Grease fittings and food-grade lubrication, Operating Temperature Range, Vibration and Noise Damping, Self-Aligning Capability, Non-Magnetic Properties, Thermal Insulation. Applications : Pharmaceutical Machinery, Sewage and Water Treatment, Textile Industry, Material Handling, Agricultural Equipment, Medical and Laboratory Equipment, HVAC Systems, Printing Machinery. CC=Close Cover.

The TP-SSBPY bearing is a high-performance two-bolt  thermoplastic pillow block bearing unit designed specifically for environments requiring high corrosion resistance and hygiene, such as food processing and chemical industries. Material : Polybutylene terephthalate (PBT) thermoplastic, often reinforced with glass fiber. AISI 440C stainless steel for inner/outer rings and balls; AISI 302/304 for the cage and set screws. Features are : Solid Base Design, Smooth Surface Finish, Thermal and Electrical Insulation, High-Grade Sealing, High Load Capacity, Zerk Fitting Orientation, Wide Temperature Range, Lightweight Design, Set Screw Locking, Food-Grade Lubrication, Precision and Noise, Vibration Damping. Applications : Pharmaceutical and Medical Equipment, Sewage and Wastewater Treatment, Conveyor Systems, Packaging Machinery, Printing Equipment, Marine and Offshore Equipment, Robotics and Automation, HVAC and Ventilation. CC=Close Cover.

The TP-SAPY bearings is a high-performance, corrosion-resistant two-bolt thermoplastic tapped-base pillow block bearing unit. It is specifically engineered for environments that require extreme hygiene, such as food processing and pharmaceutical manufacturing. Material: PBT (Polybutylene Terephthalate) thermoplastic, which is resistant to many chemicals and corrosion. Bearing Insert features an eccentric locking collar (SAPY series) with either chrome or stainless steel inserts. Features are : FDA Compliance, Vibration Damping, Thermal Insulation, Anti-Bacterial Protection, Reinforced Solid Base, Self-Alignment Capability, Load Ratings, Lightweight Efficiency, Wide Temperature Range, Easy Relubrication, Food-Grade Lubrication. CC=Close Cover.

The SSUCT bearing is a stainless steel take-up bearing unit designed for use in environments requiring high corrosion resistance. It is a take-up bearing unit, meaning it is designed to be mounted in a guide frame and uses a positioning screw to adjust the bearing\'s position and maintain proper belt or chain tension in applications like conveyor systems. The bearing insert uses two grub (set) screws for secure and precise shaft mounting. Material : The housing is made from SUS304 stainless steel, and the inner/outer rings and balls of the insert bearing are made from SUS440 stainless steel for superior corrosion resistance. The insert features silicone rubber seals for effective protection against dust and contamination. Features are : Ease of Maintenance, Self-Alignment Capability, Low Noise and Vibration, Operating Temperature Range, Anti-Rotation Pin, Hygiene & Washdown Suitability. Applications : Food and Beverage Processing, Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Chemical and Agricultural Machinery, Marine and Coastal Environments, Water Treatment Facilities, Textile Industry, Pulp and Paper Mills, Mining and Ore Processing.

The SSUCT bearing is a stainless steel take-up bearing unit designed for use in environments requiring high corrosion resistance. It is a take-up bearing unit, meaning it is designed to be mounted in a guide frame and uses a positioning screw to adjust the bearing\'s position and maintain proper belt or chain tension in applications like conveyor systems. The bearing insert uses two grub (set) screws for secure and precise shaft mounting. Material : The housing is made from SUS304 stainless steel, and the inner/outer rings and balls of the insert bearing are made from SUS440 stainless steel for superior corrosion resistance. The insert features silicone rubber seals for effective protection against dust and contamination. Features are : Ease of Maintenance, Self-Alignment Capability, Low Noise and Vibration, Operating Temperature Range, Anti-Rotation Pin, Hygiene & Washdown Suitability. Applications : Food and Beverage Processing, Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Chemical and Agricultural Machinery, Marine and Coastal Environments, Water Treatment Facilities, Textile Industry, Pulp and Paper Mills, Mining and Ore Processing. The SSUET bearing is a stainless steel take-up bearing unit, specifically engineered for corrosive, high-moisture, or hygienic environments. It combines a stainless steel take-up housing with a specialized concentric locking bearing insert to provide adjustable shaft tensioning and superior rust resistance. Material: A wide-slot take-up housing made from quality austenitic 300 series (SUS 304) stainless steel. Both inner and outer rings and the rolling elements are constructed from 400 series martensitic stainless steel (SUS 440) for high strength and durability. The retainer, slinger, frame, and grease nipple are also made from stainless steel (typically SUS 201 or 304). Features are : Wide-Slot Mounting, NSF Food-Grade Grease, Relubricatable Design, Self-Alignment, Vibration Mitigation, Shaft Protection, Easy Maintenance, Take-Up Functionality, Temperature Resilience. Applications : Conveyor Systems, Packaging Machinery, Mixing Equipment, Medical and Pharmaceutical Manufacturing , Maritime Machinery, Chemical Processing, Textile Machinery, Agricultural Equipment, Car Wash Systems.

Material: A wide-slot take-up housing made from quality austenitic 300 series (SUS 304) stainless steel. Both inner and outer rings and the rolling elements are constructed from 400 series martensitic stainless steel (SUS 440) for high strength and durability. The retainer, slinger, frame, and grease nipple are also made from stainless steel (typically SUS 201 or 304). Features are : Wide-Slot Mounting, NSF Food-Grade Grease, Relubricatable Design, Self-Alignment, Vibration Mitigation, Shaft Protection, Easy Maintenance, Take-Up Functionality, Temperature Resilience. Applications : Conveyor Systems, Packaging Machinery, Mixing Equipment, Medical and Pharmaceutical Manufacturing , Maritime Machinery, Chemical Processing, Textile Machinery, Agricultural Equipment, Car Wash Systems.

The SSUCT bearing is a stainless steel take-up bearing unit designed for use in environments requiring high corrosion resistance. It is a take-up bearing unit, meaning it is designed to be mounted in a guide frame and uses a positioning screw to adjust the bearing\'s position and maintain proper belt or chain tension in applications like conveyor systems. The bearing insert uses two grub (set) screws for secure and precise shaft mounting. Material : The housing is made from SUS304 stainless steel, and the inner/outer rings and balls of the insert bearing are made from SUS440 stainless steel for superior corrosion resistance. The insert features silicone rubber seals for effective protection against dust and contamination. Features are : Ease of Maintenance, Self-Alignment Capability, Low Noise and Vibration, Operating Temperature Range, Anti-Rotation Pin, Hygiene & Washdown Suitability. Applications : Food and Beverage Processing, Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Chemical and Agricultural Machinery, Marine and Coastal Environments, Water Treatment Facilities, Textile Industry, Pulp and Paper Mills, Mining and Ore Processing. CC=Close Cover.

The bearing insert uses two grub (set) screws for secure and precise shaft mounting. Material : The housing is made from SUS304 stainless steel, and the inner/outer rings and balls of the insert bearing are made from SUS440 stainless steel for superior corrosion resistance. The insert features silicone rubber seals for effective protection against dust and contamination. Features are : Ease of Maintenance, Self-Alignment Capability, Low Noise and Vibration, Operating Temperature Range, Anti-Rotation Pin, Hygiene & Washdown Suitability. Applications : Food and Beverage Processing, Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Chemical and Agricultural Machinery, Marine and Coastal Environments, Water Treatment Facilities, Textile Industry, Pulp and Paper Mills, Mining and Ore Processing. CC=Close Cover.

THREAD=M6. The SBPFT bearing is a three-bolt pressed steel triangular flange housed bearing unit, known for its lightweight and cost-effective design suitable for light-duty applications. Material : The housing is made from pressed steel strips, which are typically zinc-plated for protection against corrosion. This makes the unit significantly lighter than traditional cast iron units. The insert is a deep groove ball bearing made from Gcr15 (AISI 52100) bearing steel for the inner and outer rings and rolling elements. It has a spherical outer surface, which allows it to swivel within the housing. The bearing features contact-type seals on both sides to prevent the ingress of dirt, water, and foreign matter, ensuring a longer service life. Features are : Set-Screw Locking, Pre-Lubricated and Re-lubricatable, High Elasticity and Shock Resistance, Complete Interchangeability. Applications : Agricultural Machinery, Conveyor Systems, HVAC Equipment, General Manufacturing and Packaging Equipment, Textile and Printing Machinery, Automation Systems.

THREAD=M10. The UCWPA bearing is a compact, tapped-base pillow block bearing unit. Unlike standard pillow blocks that bolt through the top, this unit features threaded (tapped) holes in its base, allowing it to be mounted from the underside for a narrower, cleaner installation. The UCWPA series features a solid cast iron base. This increases structural rigidity, reduces the risk of housing fracture under heavy loads, and provides superior vibration damping. Material : The internal rolling elements and rings are manufactured from Gcr15 high-carbon chromium steel (AISI 52100), ensuring high wear resistance and a hardness rating of 58-64 HRC. The housing is made from HT200 cast grey iron, which offers high vibration damping and rigidity. It is typically finished with an anti-corrosive green paint. Features are : Relubrication Facility, Pre-Lubricated Design, Thermal Resilience, Self-Alignment Capability, Compact Footprint, Wide Temperature Range, Anti-Rotation Pin. Applications : Conveyor Systems, Packaging Machinery, Textile Equipment, CNC & 3D Printing, Agricultural Machinery, HVAC Systems, Food & Beverage, Mining Equipment, Construction Machinery.

The UCWT bearings is a standard-duty, metric take-up bearing unit. It is specifically designed for applications requiring adjustable shaft tensioning, such as belt conveyors and material handling systems, and is built to withstand initial static misalignment. Material : The bearing rings and balls are made of GCr15 (AISI 52100) high-carbon chrome steel for maximum wear resistance. The housing is typically cast from HT200 grey iron using an automatic vertical molding process to ensure structural consistency and high shock absorption. Standard units are finished with a dark green powder coating, and the grease zerk fittings are made of zinc-plated A3 steel to resist rust. Features are : Secure Shaft Locking, Wide Temperature Range, Maintenance Friendly, High and Low Temperature Grease, Anti-Rotation Pin. Applicaitons : Material Handling & Conveyor System, Agricultural Machinery, Food & Beverage Processing, Textile & Printing Machinery, Elevator Systems, Power Transmissions, Fans and Blowers, Construction Machinery.

Material : The inner and outer rings are made of Gcr15 (AISI 52100) steel, and the balls are G10 grade. The housing made from HT200 cast grey iron. Features an integrated zinc-plated A3 steel zerk fitting for maintenance. Features are : Acoustic & Vibration Testing, Shaft Protection, Anti-Rotation Mechanism, Enhanced Sealing and Lubrication, Reduced Cost of Ownership, Extended Shaft Life, Residual Magnetism Testing, Food-Grade Options, Self-Alignment. Applications : Material Handling, HVAC and Air Handling, Agricultural Machinery, Packaging and Printing, Food & Beverage Processing, Textile and Dyeing, Airport & Aviation, Pumps & Compressors.

Material : The bearing insert made from high-carbon chromium steel (GCr15/AISI 52100) for high wear resistance and hardness. The housing made from high-grade cast iron for maximum vibration damping and rigidity. Features are : Precision Mounting , Extended Inner Ring with Set Screw Locking, Maintenance-Friendly Design, Anti-Rotation Pin, Vibration Damping, Temperature Stability, Load Handling. Applications : Conveyor Systems, Agricultural Machinery, Textile & Printing Machinery, Food & Beverage Processing, Construction & Cement, Industrial Fans & Blowers, Automotive Parts, Cement & Concrete Industry, Aerospace & Transportation, Power Transmission Systems, Sporting & Consumer Goods.

THREAD=M8. The NAFC...S bearing is a professional-grade, four-bolt flange cartridge bearing unit engineered for industrial transmission and motion control systems. It is specifically designed for applications where a shaft must pass through a machine frame or wall, utilizing a piloted (spigot) flange to ensure precise centering and alignment. The NA2 series insert features a compact, narrow inner ring design, making it suitable for applications with limited axial space. Material : Both the inner and outer rings of the bearing are constructed from Gcr15 (AISI 52100) high-carbon chrome steel, and the unit uses G10 grade steel balls with a steel cage. The housing  made of HT200 cast grey iron. Features are : Reliable Lubrication,Vibration Resistance, Shaft Protection, Temperature Range, Anti-Rotation Pin, Grease Compatibility. Applications: Conveyor Systems, HVAC Equipment, Food and Beverage Processing, Textile Machinery, Construction and Agricultural Machinery, Industrial Machinery & Equipment, Precision Automation & Technology, Precision & Mechanical Engineering. S= Stainless Steel.

Its core features include a concentric 360-degree shaft grip, self-alignment up to 2°. Material : Both the inner and outer rings and the balls are made from Gcr15 (AISI 52100) high-carbon chromium steel with a sheet steel cage. The housing is made of gray cast iron. Features are : Re-lubrication Ready, Self-Alignment, Shaft Tolerance Flexibility, Operating Temperature, Recommended Torque, High Load Capacity, Vibration Damping, High-Speed Stability. Applications : Conveyor and Transfer Systems, Agricultural Machinery, Packaging and Automation, Food and Beverage Processing, Industrial Fans and Blowers, Precision Textile Machinery, Plastic & Chemical Engineering, Heavy-Duty & Harsh Environment Uses, Advanced Industrial & Technical Applications.

THREAD=M8. The UCFB bearing is a three-bolt flange bracket bearing unit consisting of a insert bearing pre-mounted in an cast iron housing. It is specifically designed for mounting on vertical surfaces or in compact machine sides where a traditional square flange might be too large. Material : The UC insert is made of GCr15 (AISI 52100) chrome steel with a standard-duty wide inner ring. The housing made from HT200 cast grey iron, typically painted dark green for corrosion resistance. Features are : Anti-Rotation Pin, Annealed Setscrew Port, Oil Groove Alignment, Self-Alignment Capability, Re-lubricatable Design. Applications : Conveyor and Transfer Systems, Manufacturing and Automation, Agricultural Machinery, HVAC and Air Handling, Food and Beverage Processing, Water and Waste Management, Construction and Mining, Commercial Goods, Packaging and Automation Equipment, Textile and Printing Machinery.

desc: SELF LUBE CAST IRON PILLOW BLOCK UNITS
tech: The NP...DEC RHP is a premium, heavy-duty cast iron pillow block bearing unit engineered for rigid industrial shaft support. Manufactured by RHP this Self-Lube® assembly consists of a durable two-bolt rigid housing paired with a specialized high-performance insert. The eccentric collar design grips the shaft securely in applications where rotation happens primarily in one direction. Material : The housing is made of close-grained grey cast iron, while the internal bearing components are forged from through-hardened, high-cleanliness carbon steel. Features are : Shaft Stability, Misalignment Prevention, Stress Reduction, Vibration Damping, Super-Finished Raceways, High-Speed Stability, Wide Thermal Range, Replaceable Insert, Easy Maintenance. Applications : Material Handling Conveyors, Industrial Fans and Blowers, Agricultural Machinery, Packaging and Bottling Lines, Textile and Paper Mills, Food Processing Machinery, Pumps Small Compressors, Mining and Quar,ry Screening, Woodworking Machinery. DEC=Eccentric Collar & Long Inner Ring.

desc: SELF LUBE CAST IRON PILLOW BLOCK UNITS
tech: The RHP NP...EC is a metric, two-bolt cast iron pillow block housed bearing unit engineered by RHP. It belongs to the acclaimed Self-Lube®, characterized by its modular design, pre-lubricated internals, and capability to accommodate initial housing misalignment during installation. The defining attribute of this specific model is its EC-type locking mechanism, which utilizes an eccentric collar over a short, flush inner ring to deliver high-torque shaft security under uni-directional rotations. A rigid, single-piece structure manufactured from high-tensile grey iron. It incorporates two slotted bolt holes at the base for flexible horizontal positioning during alignment. Material : A high-tensile grey cast iron housing containing a through-hardened, vacuum-degassed carbon chromium steel bearing insert. Features are : Misalignment Compensation, Reduced Stress, Internal Lubrication Groove, Super-Finished Raceways, Replaceable Insert. Applications : Material Handling & Logistics, Packaging & Processing Machinery, Food & Agriculture Electronics, Printing Presses, Textile Production Lines, Laboratory, Medical, & Test Equipment. EC=Excentric Collar Lock With Flush Inner Ring On One Side.

Part of the popular Self-Lube® industrial range, this medium-duty housed bearing consists of a rigid cast iron housing and a sealed, wide inner ring bearing insert. Utilizes a set-screw (grub screw) lock system to anchor tightly onto the shaft. Material : Consists of a high-tensile grey cast iron housing enclosing a vacuum-degassed through-hardened steel bearing insert sealed with nitrile rubber. Features are : Self-Alignment Capability, Set-Screw Shaft Locking, Super-Finished Raceways, Bi-Directional Support, Replaceable Insert, Lubrication & Maintenance, Wide Temperature Threshold, Vibration Dampening, Extended Service Life, Cost-Efficient. Applications : Agricultural & Forestry Machinery, Material Handling & Conveyor Systems, Packaging & Bottling Lines, Food Processing, Textile Machinery, Mining, Quarrying & Construction Machinery, Woodworking & Forestry, Marine & Ports, Industrial Fans & Blowers.

desc: SELF LUBE CAST IRON PILLOW BLOCK UNITS
tech: THREAD=M8x1.25. The RHP SNP...DEC is a premium-grade, short-base cast iron pillow block housed bearing unit engineered for mechanical power transmission in confined industrial spaces. Manufactured under the RHP Self-Lube® unit features a cast iron housing paired with a robust bearing insert. Unlike standard pillow blocks that feature wide, sweeping side wings for mounting bolts. The mounting bolt holes are moved inwards, allowing the unit to fit snugly into small machine frames. It is cast from high-tensile gray iron to handle high vibrational stresses and heavy radial loads. Features are : Space-Saving Footprint, Self-Lube and Relubrication, Spherical Outer Ring, Super-Finished Raceways, Misalignment Mitigation, Anti-Rotation Pin. Applications : Material Handling & Conveyor Systems, Textile Machines, Printing Presses & Paper Mills, Food Processing, Agricultural & Environmental Equipment, Air Handling, HVAC & Clean Air Technology, Construction & Quarry Auxiliary Equipment. DEC=Eccentric Collar Lock With Extended Inner Ring.

Manufactured under the RHP Self-Lube® unit features a cast iron housing paired with a robust bearing insert. Unlike standard pillow blocks that feature wide, sweeping side wings for mounting bolts. The mounting bolt holes are moved inwards, allowing the unit to fit snugly into small machine frames. It is cast from high-tensile gray iron to handle high vibrational stresses and heavy radial loads. Features are : Space-Saving Footprint, Self-Lube and Relubrication, Spherical Outer Ring, Super-Finished Raceways, Misalignment Mitigation, Anti-Rotation Pin. Applications : Material Handling & Conveyor Systems, Textile Machines, Printing Presses & Paper Mills, Food Processing, Agricultural & Environmental Equipment, Air Handling, HVAC & Clean Air Technology, Construction & Quarry Auxiliary Equipment. DEC=Eccentric Collar Lock With Extended Inner Ring.

desc: SELF LUBE CAST IRON PILLOW BLOCK UNITS
tech: The RHP SNP is a premium, normal-duty short base (tapped base) pillow block bearing unit. Manufactured by NSK RHP, this integrated assembly features a compact cast iron housing design that optimizes spatial layouts where a standard wide-footprint pillow block. The outer ring features a precision-ground spherical seating that automatically accommodates radians of initial shaft misalignment during installation. Material : A durable Grade 200 gray cast iron housing paired with a through-hardened 52100 high-carbon chromium steel bearing insert. Features are : Space-Saving Structural Design, Secure Shaft Locking System, Replaceable Insert Assembly, Integrated Re-Lubrication System, Super-Finished Raceways, Anti-Rotation Pin. Applications : Material Handling & Conveyor Systems, Food & Beverage Processing, Agricultural & Outdoor Power Equipment, Air Handling & HVAC Systems, Texturing, Printing & Paper Mill Machinery, Woodworking & Sawmill Equipment, Medical & Pharmaceutical Processing.

The RHP LFTC...EC is a high-precision, normal-duty two-bolt oval cast iron flanged bearing unit manufactured under the RHP Self-Lube® family. The cast iron flange utilizes a space-saving oval shape with two pre-cast bolt holes, making it ideal for machinery walls, frameworks, and side panels where side-by-side spacing is restricted. Material : Constructed from a heavy-duty BS1452 grey cast iron housing paired with a through-hardened, high-carbon chrome steel bearing insert. Features are : Shaft Locking Mechanism, Super-Finished Raceways, Spherical Self-Alignment, Removable Modular Insert, Operating Temperature, Anti-Rotation Pin, Vibration Dampening, Low Friction Factor. Applications : Material Handling Systems, Agricultural Machinery, Food, Beverage & Packaging Processing, Textiles & Printing Machinery, Woodworking Machinery, Renewable Energy Systems. EC=Excentric Collar Lock With Flush Inner Ring On One Side.

The RHP LFTC is a premium, two-bolt oval flanged Self-Lube® bearing unit manufactured by RHP. It comprises a high-grade cast iron housing  and a pre-lubricated bearing insert. This specific configuration is tailored for tight mechanical spaces where a standard four-bolt square flange cannot fit. This allows the bearing to swivel and automatically adjust for initial shaft misalignment or frame flexing during assembly. Material : Cast iron housing paired with a high-carbon, through-hardened chromium steel bearing insert. Features are : Space-Saving Footprint, Misalignment Compensation, Vibration Dampening, Low Friction Factor, Super-Finished Raceways, Anti-Rotation Pin, Integrated Relubrication Facility, Broad Thermal Range, High Load Distribution. Applications : Material Handling & Conveyor Systems, Agricultural Machinery, Food & Beverage Processing, Printing & Paper Conversion, HVAC & Air Handling Units, Laboratory & Medical Hardware, Woodworking Machinery, Renewable Energy Systems, Textile Machinery.

This compensates for structural flexing or initial shaft misalignment during installation. Material : High-grade cast iron housing paired with a premium, vacuum-degassed chrome steel bearing insert for maximum shock absorption and wear resistance. Features are : Minimized Vibration, Super-Finished Raceways, Anti-Rotation Pin, Shaft Locking & Stability, Built-in Relubrication Facility, Dynamic Balancing Stability, Wide Temperature Range. Applications : Material Handling & Conveyors, Agricultural Machinery, Industrial Fans and Blowers, Textile & Paper Mill Rollers, Food Processing Machinery, Packaging and Bottling Lines, Woodworking Equipment. The RHP FC is a normal-duty, four-bolt round flanged cartridge bearing unit manufactured by RHP. This assembly consists of a precision-ground, spherical insert bearing seated inside a rigid cast iron housing. It is specifically engineered to support rotating shafts that pass through vertical or horizontal machine walls or bulkheads, where space is tight and precise cylindrical alignment is mandatory. This locates directly into a round machine cutout, taking the heavy radial alignment forces off the mounting bolts. Material : Through-hardened high-carbon chromium steel insert bearing seated inside a rugged, vibration-dampening cast iron housing. Features are : Spherical Self-Alignment, Shock Resistance, Secure Shaft Locking System, Super-Finished Raceways, High/Low-Temperature Adaptability, Low-Friction Profile, Maximum Limiting Speed, Re-lubrication Infrastructure. Applications : Material Handling, Agricultural Machinery, Food Processing & Packaging Production, Air Handling & Ventilation Systems, Textile Machinery, Woodworking Equipment, Mining, Quarrying & Construction Equipment.

The SF RHP is a heavy-duty, four-bolt square cast iron flange bearing unit. It belongs to the legendary Self-Lube product lineage, manufactured globally by RHP. The unit combines a rigid, single-piece cast iron housing with a highly engineered, pre-lubricated ball bearing insert. This structural combination handles heavy machinery configurations subject to initial structural misalignments. The outer ring of the bearing insert and the inner bore of the housing are spherically machined. This allows the internal bearing to swivel freely within the housing to automatically correct up to 0.030 radians of initial structural misalignment during installation. Features are : Secure Shaft Locking Mechanisms, Anti-Rotation Pin, Super-Finished Raceways, Extreme Temperature Tolerance. Applications : Conveyors & Material Handling, Food Processing & Packaging Machinery, Agricultural & Horticultural Equipment, HVAC & Air Handling Systems, Printing & Textile Machinery, Mining & Quarrying, Marine & Port Machinery, Woodworking Equipment.

The unit combines a rigid, single-piece cast iron housing with a highly engineered, pre-lubricated ball bearing insert. This structural combination handles heavy machinery configurations subject to initial structural misalignments. The outer ring of the bearing insert and the inner bore of the housing are spherically machined. This allows the internal bearing to swivel freely within the housing to automatically correct up to 0.030 radians of initial structural misalignment during installation. Features are : Secure Shaft Locking Mechanisms, Anti-Rotation Pin, Super-Finished Raceways, Extreme Temperature Tolerance. Applications : Conveyors & Material Handling, Food Processing & Packaging Machinery, Agricultural & Horticultural Equipment, HVAC & Air Handling Systems, Printing & Textile Machinery, Mining & Quarrying, Marine & Port Machinery, Woodworking Equipment. A=Unit Fitted With Set Screw Lock Insert With Flush Inner Ring On One Side.

The RHP SLFT...EC is a light-duty, triangular three-bolt pressed steel flange bearing unit manufactured by RHP. It is specifically designed for applications with space constraints, low-to-moderate loads, and where weight saving is critical. The bearing has a spherical outer ring that mirrors the housing cavity, allowing it to automatically adjust and correct initial shaft misalignment during installation. The dual-plate, high-strength pressed steel construction delivers a compact, low-profile footprint and minimizes overall machine weight. Material : High-chromium steel bearing insert housed within a corrosion-resistant, zinc-plated pressed steel assembly. Features are : Vibration Dampening, Low Initial Startup Torque, Quiet Running Geometry, Maintenance-Free Life, Antirotation Pin Compatibility, Cost-Efficient Replacement, Low Axial Envelope. Applications : Agricultural & Harvesting Machinery, Material Handling & Logistics, HVAC & Air Handling Systems, Packaging & Bottling Automation, Woodworking & Construction Auxiliaries. desc: CAST IRON CONVEYOR BELT TENSIONER UNITS
tech: The BT... EC RHP  is a heavy-duty, self-lubricating cast iron conveyor belt tensioner unit. This self-lube mechanical bearing component is built to facilitate precise tracking alignment and maintain optimal pressure across heavy belt systems. The unit is composed of a rigid cast iron housing shaped with integrated guide grooves, allowing it to slide smoothly along a tracking frame or guide rails. Inside the housing rests a self-aligning, premium steel ball bearing insert. This allows the unit to tolerate minor structural misalignments without sacrificing performance. Material : A heavy-duty, vibration-damping cast iron housing paired with a high-carbon, through-hardened chromium steel bearing insert. Features are : Integral Relubrication Facility, High Maximum Speed, Super-Finished Raceways, Anti-Rotation Security Pin, Shaft Retention & Locking Mechanics, Extreme Thermal Stabilization. Applications : Material Handling, Food Processing & Bottling, Agricultural Machinery, Pulp, Paper, and Printing Systems, HVAC, Air Handling, and Fans. EC=Excentric Collar Lock With Flush Inner Ring On One Side.

desc: SELF-LUBE CAST IRON HANGER BEARING UNITS
tech: The RHP SCHB is a high-capacity Self-Lube Cast Iron Hanger Bearing Unit engineered by RHP. It is specifically designed to support overhead suspended shafts, line shafts, screw conveyors, and industrial material handling systems. The unit consists of a high-grade rigid cast iron housing paired with a pre-lubricated, replaceable ball bearing insert. The outer perimeter of the insert is curved (spherical). It matches the internal contour of the iron casing, allowing the unit to self-align and automatically accommodate minor structural shaft deflections or angular misalignment. Material : High-tensile grey cast iron housing for structural vibration-dampening paired with a high-purity chrome steel internal bearing for rolling-fatigue resistance. Features are : Re-lubrication Facility, Secure Shaft Locking Mechanism, Super-Finished Raceways, Anti-Rotation Pin, Wide Operating Temperature Range. Applications : Mining & Quarrying Facilities, Pulp & Paper Mills, Industrial Fan & Ventilation Systems, Food Processing Machinery, Energy, Power Generation, & Utilities, Marine & Port Facilities, Metal Processing & Foundries.

desc: SELF-LUBE CAST IRON HANGER BEARING UNITS
tech: THREAD=M16 x 2.00. The SCH RHP is a heavy-duty, self-aligning cast iron hanger bearing unit manufactured by RHP. Utilizes two precision grub screws (set screws) on the inner ring extension. They bite directly into the shaft to lock the bearing tightly in place and prevent slippage. This self-lubricating unit is heavily utilized in industrial transmission equipment and conveyor machinery. The internal bearing insert features a spherical outer diameter that matches a curved internal housing seat. This allows the bearing to swivel up to a few degrees to automatically correct shaft misalignment without placing stress on the balls. Features are : Super-Finished Raceways, Replaceable Core Design, Anti-Rotation Pin, Tightening Torque Limit, Easy Installation, High Maximum Speed, Suspension Mounting, Relubrication System. Applications : Industrial Mixing & Agitation, Food Processing & Packaging Lines, Air Handling & HVAC Systems, Agricultural Equipment, Wastewater Treatment & Fluid Processing, Textile & Paper Manufacturing, Marine & Port Facilities.

It snaps onto the housing to shield the machine operator from hazardous rotating shaft ends. It also keeps external contaminants like water and dust away from the bearing surfaces. Material : Manufactured fromindustrial-grade PBT (Polybutylene Terephthalate) thermoplastic matrix engineered for severe operating environments. Features are : High Chemical Resistance, Extreme Temperature Stability, Washdown Environment Compatibility, Ultra-Lightweight Body, Zero Maintenance Requirement, Corrosion-Resistant Design, Improved Bearing Protection, Cost-Effective Accessory, Vibration-Damping Fit, Low Moisture Absorption. Applications : Food Processing Machinery, Packaging Equipment, Pharmaceutical Machinery, Agricultural Machinery, Textile Machinery, Marine, Aquaculture & Offshore Environments, Printing & Paper Processing Machinery, Construction Equipment. P = Protector (End Cover).

BEARING INSERT NO= VE-108. The Browning VPE is an intermediate-duty, two-bolt pillow block mounted ball bearing unit featuring an eccentric locking collar. It consists of a durable cast-iron housing pre-assembled with a high-grade, self-aligning ball bearing insert. The collar grips the shaft securely by tightening in the direction of shaft rotation, preventing slippage under high vibration. The outer ring of the bearing insert has a spherical surface that matches the housing bore. This compensates for minor shaft misalignment during installation. Material : A rugged malleable iron housing coated in powder-coat epoxy, enclosing a high-precision insert made of durable 52100 chrome steel bearing insert. Features are : Semi-Solid Base, Localized Heat Treatment, Super-Honed Raceways, Extended Lubrication Maintenance, Shock-Resistant, Shaft Protection, Wide Temperature Range, Maximum Rated Speed, Anti-Rotation Pin. Applications : Air Handling and HVAC Systems, Conveyors & Material Handling, Packaging Machinery, Agricultural & Food Processing Equipment, Textile Machinery, Printing Presses & Paper Converting, Woodworking Equipment.

Browning solves this by zone-hardening the inner race and utilizing proprietary diamond-cut tips angled at a 120° footprint to maximize shaft grip without causing severe galling. Material : It features a rugged cast iron housing finished in powder-coat epoxy, an inner core made of high-purity 52100 chrome steel, and a protective nitrile rubber single-lip contact seal paired with a steel flinger. Features are : Anti-Rotation Rivet, Dynamic Misalignment Capability, Maintenance & Lubrication Design, Superfinished Raceways, Fixed Non-Expansion Design, Maximum Rotational Speed, Operating Temperature Limits, Replacement Insert. Applications : Material Handling & Conveyors, Industrial HVAC, Fans & Blowers, Food, Beverage & Packaging Machinery, Agricultural & Forestry Equipment, Aggregate, Mining & Crushing, Wastewater Treatment & Fluid Handling, Energy, Power Generation & Recycling.

BEARING INSERT NO= VE-112. The VTWE is an intermediate-duty, wide-slot take-up mounted ball bearing featuring an eccentric locking collar. It is utilizes a wide inner ring insert bearing engineered to handle radial loads while allowing linear adjustment along machine frames. The eccentric collar uses an offset cam design machined into the bearing\'s inner ring extension. When the collar is mated to the shaft and rotated in the direction of system movement, it wedges securely onto the shaft. A single setscrew locks the collar in place, providing gripping power without distorting the inner ball path. Material : Durable cast iron housing, high-carbon 52100 bearing steel, and a single-lip elastomer contact seal paired with a black-oxide steel external flinger. Features are : Anti-Rotation Rivet, Non-Expansion (Fixed) Anchorage, Integrated Grooved Outer Ring, Dynamic Misalignment Compensation, Superfinished Ball Paths, Maximum Speed, Temperature Limits. Applications : Food Processing & Packaging, Agricultural Machinery, Industrial Fan & Blower Systems, Pulp, Paper, & Converting Mills, Wastewater Treatment Facilities, Mining & Quarry Processing, Industrial Mixing & Agitation.

Uses two setscrews positioned exactly 120 degrees apart on the inner ring. This creates a balanced three-point contact design that minimizes inner ring distortion, stabilizes the shaft, and reduces structural vibration. Material : Durable cast iron housing (epoxy powder-coated), high-carbon 52100 bearing steel, and a single-lip elastomer contact seal paired with a black-oxide steel external flinger. Features are : Anti-Rotation Rivet, Standard Relubrication Port, Spherical Outer Diameter, Super-Finished Raceways, Extended Inner Ring Footprint, Non-Expansion (Fixed) Constraint, Maximum Limiting Speed, Operating Temperature, Replacement Bearing Insert. Applications :  Food Processing & Packaging, Agricultural Machinery, Industrial Fan & Blower Systems, Pulp, Paper, & Converting Mills, Wastewater Treatment Facilities, Mining & Quarry Processing, Industrial Mixing & Agitation.

The LRS is a specialized, industrial-grade ball bearing insert manufactured by Browning Brand. It functions as a replacement insert inside light-duty mounted bearing assemblies, providing dependable shaft support in clean or light-particle mechanical environments. The spherical shape of the outer ring can pivot within its housing up to ±1.5 degrees to accommodate minor mounting imbalances, frame flexing, or shaft deviations. Material : Constructed from high-purity, vacuum-degassed 52100 chrome steel for its hard-wearing raceways and Grade 10 balls, paired with a ductile zone-hardened collar, a low-friction glass-reinforced nylon cage, and protective nitrile rubber contact seals. Features are : Extended Inner Ring, Lubricated-for-Life Design, Anti-Rotation Rivet, Broad Temperature Range, Superfinished Raceways, Low Running-Torque Profile, Setscrew Locking Mechanism, Maximum Operating Speed. Applications : Material Handling & Logistics, HVAC & Air Moving Equipment, Agricultural & Food Processing, Paper, Printing & Packaging Automation, Medical, Lab & Clean-Room Auxiliaries, Woodworking Equipment

desc: PLUMMER BLOCK AND FLANGED HOUSING UNIT
tech: These bearing is a specialized, industrial-grade flanged radial insert ball bearing housing unit manufactured by INA. It is engineered primarily as a heavy-duty mechanical component capable of supporting rotating shafts under high vibration and demanding operational conditions. This is a complete, pre-assembled plummer block and flanged housing unit. It combines a heavy-duty outer housing with a self-aligning radial insert ball bearing inside. Material : The housing unit features a rigid grey cast iron outer housing fitted with a high-grade chrome steel internal insert bearing. Features are : Self-Alignment Ability, Lubrication Type, Ready-to-Fit Design, High Load-to-Weight Ratio, Reduced Friction Coefficient, Extended Fatigue Life, Relaxed Structural Tolerances. Applications : Agricultural Machinery & Harvesting Equipment, Conveyor & Bulk Material Handling Systems, Food Processing & Feed Mill Equipment, Industrial Fan and Blower Blowers, Textile & Paper Processing Rollers. P=Plummer block / Housing Unit, M=Centering Spigot (Spigot Lip), N=Sealing System, E=Endurance / Maintenance-Free.

These bearing is a complete cast iron take-up housing assembly engineered by INA. It is specifically designed to function as an integrated bearing system that combines structural support with belt/chain tensioning capabilities. It features a heavy-duty take-up housing unit. The frame contains guide slots on the sides, allowing the entire block to slide linearly along a rail or frame to adjust shaft positioning or belt tension. The unit serves as a standard belt/chain tensioner component. By adjusting the linear positioning of the take-up housing, operators can easily control or correct slack in conveyor belts or power transmission systems. Material : The housing is made of high-grade cast iron, and the internal bearing is made of fully-hardened chromium steel. Features are : Spherical Self-Alignment Mechanism, Integrated Relubrication Port, Vibration Dampening, Bi-Directional High Load Capacity, High Thermal Endurance, Reduced Long-Term Friction. Applications : Agricultural Equipment, Packaging and Bottling Lines, Textile & Paper Processing Machinery, Woodworking Equipment, Food & Beverage Container Lines. RTUE=Radial insert ball bearing Take-Up Element.

desc: CAST IRON TWO-BOLT FLANGED HOUSING UNITS
tech: Bearing No=SB 201. These bearing is a two-bolt flanged housing unit manufactured by PTI. It is explicitly categorized as a normal-duty mechanical component used widely across automated lines, conveyors, and generic manufacturing equipment where shaft alignment and support are critical. Manufactured from high-grade cast iron providing rigidity, vibration dampening, and resilience against physical distortion under structural loads. Cross-referenced internationally under the PCFTY series design standard. Utilizes a standard set screw configuration built directly onto the inner ring of the bearing insert, ensuring robust and concentric locking to the shaft. Material : Constructed with a high-grade grey cast iron housing fitted with a precision-ground chrome steel bearing insert. Features are : Self-Aligning Capability, Load Distribution Layout, Pre-Lubricated & Serviceable, Wide Thermal Adaptability, High Anti-Fretting Protection, Interchangeable Design Layout, Anti-Rotation Pin Control. Applications : Packaging & Labeling Machinery, Food & Beverage Processing, Printing & Paper Converting, Agricultural Machinery, Textile & Apparel Manufacturing, Pharmaceutical & Medical Manufacturing, Woodworking & Lumber Processing, Renewable Energy Systems. S=Set Screw Locking Method.

BEARING INSERT=SS-UC201, HOUSING=SS-P201, THREAD=M10. These blocks are specialized, corrosion-resistant stainless steel pillow block bearing unit engineered to support rotating shafts parallel to a mounting surface. Widely utilized in cleanrooms, pharmaceutical hubs, marine decks, and chemical plants, it is the primary standard for washdown environments where conventional cast iron units would quickly rust or contaminate production lines. Employs two dual set-screws (grub screws) offset at 120° on the inner ring extension. Tightening clamps the ring tightly onto the shaft. The recommended shaft tolerance class is h6 or js6 to prevent the shaft from spinning loose under alternating loads. Material : The unit consists of an AISI 304 stainless steel housing, an AISI 420C stainless steel bearing, and a NBR nitrile rubber lip seal with a stainless steel slinger. Features are : Spherical Self-Alignment, Anti-Rotation Pin, Food-Safe Pre-Lubrication, High Radial and Axial Load Balance, Optimized Thermal Management, Low-Friction Internal Kinematics,  Low Noise & Vibration Dampening. Applications : Marine, Offshore & Coastal Machinery, Paper Mills, Pulping & Printing Infrastructure, Wastewater Treatment & Environmental Engineering, Agricultural Equipment, Pharmaceutical & Medical Production.
